entries.title: VS Code v1_140: Source Control
entries.description: Reuse ignored folders across worktrees (Experimental) Setting:git.worktreeSymlinkFoldersOpen in VS CodeOpen in VS Code Insiders Avoid reinstalling dependencies or duplicating large build artifacts in eachGit worktree. Configuregit.worktreeSymlinkFoldersOpen in VS CodeOpen in VS Code Insiderswith.gitignore-style patterns for ignored folders, such asnode_modules. When VS Code creates a new worktree, including for an agent session, it creates symlinks to matching folders in the current checkout.

entries.title: VS Code v1_140: Accessibility

The joyful sound plays when chat thumbs-up confetti appears and when you successfully mark a session as done in the Agents window.
